title: Chapter 160 - 160 Another Truckload Of Luxury Goods; Touching!
content:
Chapter 160 - 160 Another Truckload Of Luxury Goods; Touching!

Chapter 160 - 160 Another Truckload of Luxury Goods; Touching!

160 Another Truckload of Luxury Goods; Touching!

The next day.

When the sun rose slowly, Lin Fan finally got up from the big bed in the Coiling Dragon Villa.

His phone rang.

Lin Fan looked at the caller ID. It was a familiar number.

“Hello?”

“Hello, Mr. Lin. I’m from the transportation company. We have some of your items. Do you still want to send them to Yi Ke City?” A dull voice came from the phone.

Lin Fan immediately thought of a person.

A few days ago, he was the one who sent a truckload of Louis Vuitton bags and clothes.

Lin Fan said, “Send them to the Coiling Dragon Villa Complex. Do you know where it is?”

“Is it the Coiling Dragon Villa Complex that’s by the lake?” the driver asked.

“Yes,” Lin Fan said.

“Okay, please wait a moment. I’ll be there in about 15 minutes,” the driver said.

Lin Fan was not in a hurry. He walked to the bathroom and washed up.

Just as he was about to take a break in the living room, his phone rang again.

“Mr. Lin, we’re here.” The driver’s voice came from the phone.

Lin Fan looked out the window.

Sure enough, a tall truck had already stopped at the entrance.

When the driver saw Lin Fan walk out, he said respectfully, “Hello, Mr. Lin.”

It was no wonder that the driver would be like this.

That was because he had delivered packages to Lin Fan twice.

Every time, it was a truck full of expensive top-notch luxury goods.

The power of such a person was simply unimaginable.

As soon as he finished speaking, the driver opened the truck’s door and revealed a truckload’s worth of Gucci clothes and bags.

“Mr. Lin, are we going to put these things in this villa?”

Even though Lin Fan was already mentally prepared, when he saw so many clothes and bags, he could not help but be dumbfounded.

“Yes, put them in the living room.” He nodded after a while.

“Alright.”

The driver responded and then moved the clothes and bags inside with two porters.

Lin Fan thought for a while and casually took some bags and placed them in the Mercedes-Benz.

In a short while, the entire living room was completely filled.

After the driver left, Lin Fan did not have any intention of resting anymore. He turned around and drove the Mercedes-Benz G-Class toward Jiangbei University.

Monday morning seemed to be more congested than at other times.

Looking ahead, the roads were filled with densely packed vehicles.

Lin Fan sat in the car, feeling a little bored. He could not help but place his attention on the sign-in system.

[Do you want to sign in?]

“Yes!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained all the property rights of Zhenhu Yuting.]

Zhenhu Yuting was a famous residential building in the center of Jiangbei City. The environment of the neighborhood was excellent, and the surrounding industries were rich. It was the ideal residence for many company bosses.

There were more than a thousand houses in the entire neighborhood!

If each house cost five million yuan, the total value was about 5 billion!

Lin Fan did some calculations and nodded his head slightly. It was not bad.

When he turned his head, he saw that the front passenger seat was already piled with property ownership certificates and large keys.

Lin Fan casually flipped through a few property ownership certificates.

‘Zhenhu Yuting Building A, Unit 201. Area: 125 square meters. Owner: Lin Fan.’

‘Zhenhu Yuting Building A, Unit 202. Area: 109 square meters. Owner: Lin Fan.’

…

Then, Lin Fan looked at the congested road in front of him. After hesitating for a moment, he finally turned the car around and headed toward Lianjia Real Estate Agency not far away.

At this moment, Han Tian was sitting in front of her desk, carefully flipping through the documents.

When she unintentionally raised her head, her entire pretty face was filled with surprise as she shouted, “Mr. Lin?

“Mr. Lin, please take a seat. I’ll pour you a cup of coffee first.”

After saying that, she quickly got up and took out a box of beautifully packaged coffee from the cabinet.

After brewing the coffee meticulously, she carefully brought it to Lin Fan.

Han Tian had a special feeling about Lin Fan.

He was rich, handsome, low-profile, and well-mannered.

The only pity was that he already had a girlfriend.

Lin Fan did not know much about coffee and just took a sip.

However, he could not help but nod his head. It was sweet and delicious, and the taste was indeed not bad.

“Mr. Lin, what a coincidence that you’re here,” Han Tian said. “I was planning to send you the rental status of Washington Palace for last month.”

As she spoke, she handed over a stack of documents under the table.

“The total rent is 800,000 yuan. If there’s no problem, I can arrange for the finance department to transfer the money in the afternoon.”

Even though Lin Fan had the scanning ability and could read all the data in one glance, he still did not accept the information.

“I won’t look at the information. I believe you!”

Han Tian was touched.

This involved nearly a million yuan, yet he trusted her so much.

Lin Fan continued, “I’m here this time to rent out Zhenhu Yuting. ”

“Sure, our Lianjia has also rented out many units in Zhenhu Yuting.”

Lin Fan nodded his head and placed a large Gucci bag on the table.

The bag was filled with property ownership certificates and keys.

Seeing this…

Han Tian could not help but be stunned. “M-Mr. Lin… This…”

“Oh, I’ve bought the entire Zhenhu Yuting. Here are the property ownership certificate and keys. I’ll be counting on you to help me rent it out in the future,” Lin Fan said.

His tone was so calm.

However, Han Tian’s ears buzzed like thunder.

The entire Zhenhu Yuting?

The average price there was about 40,000 yuan per square meter!

Buying the entire building would cost at least a few billion!

Now, he was asking her to rent it out?

Even if he could collect 100 million yuan in rent every year, it would take decades to recoup his losses.

This was definitely not worth it.

Then why did he do this?

Lin Fan ignored Han Tian’s thoughts and asked, “Do we need to sign a contract?”

“Ah… Ah… Alright, let’s sign a contract, ” Han Tian said.

As the printer made a squeaking sound, a warm contract appeared in Lin Fan’s hands.

Lin Fan casually flipped through it and signed his name.

Then, Lin Fan handed over two exquisite Gucci bags and said, “These two bags are for you.”

He looked at his watch and said, “It’s getting late. I’ll make a move first.”

He turned around and got into the Mercedes Benz G-Class, heading toward Jiangbei University again.

Han Tian was the only one left. She stood in place and stared blankly at the Mercedes-Benz G-Class that had left.

In her mind, she could not help but recall the bits and pieces of her life with Lin Fan.

Lin Fan specially invited her to Star Restaurant for a meal… to let her taste the delicacies.

Lin Fan rented out the entire Zhenhu Yuting so that… her work could go smoothly.

Lin Fan gifted her two limited edition bags from Gucci… to let herself enjoy the luxury of branded goods.

She was moved, happy, and blissful. All kinds of emotions kept surging in his heart.

Her heart began to beat faster, and a blush appeared on her pretty face.

At the same time, Lin Fan, who was driving the Mercedes-Benz, heard a clear notification in his mind.

[Ding! Charming Aura has been activated!]
